features.name: Safe Mode
features.description: Implemented local Practice-only guard. Defaults ON; native gameplay modifiers, external macro input, and auto-clicker are disabled outside an active level with the manually armed Practice Guard. When the build exposes a trusted Practice-mode hook, normal mode is also rejected. This does not intercept outbound HTTP requests and does not enforce Pointercrate/GD leaderboard rules, and cannot guarantee a run is leaderboard-eligible.
compatibility: Guard enforcement implemented; native runtime unverified
features.notes: Practice Guard is intentionally never restored from disk. The user must arm it each session. This is local risk reduction, not network submission filtering.

features.name: Auto Safe Mode
features.description: Implemented local auto-disable logic: with Practice-only Safe Mode enabled, active gameplay modifiers, macros, and auto-clicker are stopped when the level/Practice Guard is no longer confirmed. It is a local input/gameplay guard, not an outbound network request filter or an online integrity guarantee.
features.notes: The user can explicitly turn Safe Mode off. Password, account, verification, and leaderboard bypasses are not implemented.
